# AprilTag family sources

The tag family definitions (`tag*.c`) and license from
[AprilRobotics/apriltag](https://github.com/AprilRobotics/apriltag), unmodified, at commit
`b7c0ebe9aa20f82ec7a828579004f9e706bfecd9`. BSD 2-Clause; see `LICENSE.md` and each file's notice.

`tools/gen_families.py` turns them into `src/detector/families/*.rs`. To update, copy the same files
from a newer checkout, update the commit above, and rerun the generator.
